items.title: Top Democrats call to rein in AI buildout after midterms sweep: 'National data center moratorium now'
items.summary: After a big win in the U.S. midterm elections on Tuesday, some Democrats are already signaling they want to take on the artificial build-out, specifically data centers.

items.title: Barkin sees interest rate hikes ahead, but at a gradual pace
items.summary: Richmond Federal Reserve President Thomas Barkin said Thursday that he expects the central bank will have to raise interest rates further, though he's not sure by how much or at what pace.

items.title: What the Democratic midterms sweep changes for U.S.-China relations
items.summary: BEIJING — Democrats taking power from Republicans in Congress raises risks for U.S.-China tensions around Taiwan, while hardening tech competition, analysts said.

items.title: 10-year Treasury yield slides as traders mull over Democrats' midterm victories, oil prices drop
items.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield fell on Wednesday as investors weighed big wins from Democrats in the U.S. midterm elections and oil prices pulled back.

items.title: Here's what the Democratic election rout could mean for the U.S. economy

items.title: Bank of England hikes interest rate for the first time since Iran war, warns inflation will near 5%
items.summary: The Bank of England announced its first interest rate hike in over three years on Thursday, raising its key rate by 25 basis points to 4%.

items.title: Voters say the economy drove them to the polls — and blame Trump for their troubles
items.summary: As President Donald Trump campaigned for the nation's highest office in 2024, he regularly blamed Democrats for the country's economic anxiety.
